what: Addendum to prediction_whole_corpus.json: cell D2 (a second reranking NIM on the whole-corpus results) and timed passes of the reference arm on miracl-hn-ja
host: one RTX 5090, graphics driver 610.88 (as cells D and E of 2026-10-06)

cell_D2.what: cell D again with the other reranking NIM of the first session: the 100 whole-corpus results per query of cell B, one call per query
cell_D2.start: as in the first session: no profile set
cell_D2.programs: as cell D: rerank_cell.py (smoke, rerank), score_run.py --rerank-from, rerank_latency.py --where container --passes 2; the driver and its limits are those of cell D
cell_D2.reported: per language nDCG@10 before and after, Recall@100 before and after (must be equal), and per pass the p50 / p90 / p99 of a call; in one table with cell D, each reranker's own values side by side (no per-query result of one reranker is read together with the other's)

expectation.ndcg: rises on both languages, by less than with the 1b reranker: +0.005 to +0.02 (on the reduced corpora it added 0.011 for zh and 0.008 for ja, the 1b reranker 0.024 and 0.028)
expectation.call_ms_p50: 75 to 110 ms (zh) and 80 to 115 ms (ja), from the first session's 1,120 and 1,040 pairs per second; p99 below 400 ms; the second pass within 5% of the first

reference_arm_ja_throughput.what: the open weights through Sentence Transformers (the reference arm of the first session) on the first 4,096 passages of miracl-hn-ja, three timed passes after one discarded pass
reference_arm_ja_throughput.why: the first session has no timed passes for this arm on ja: at 64 per batch the step filled the card's memory (Sentence Transformers puts the longest passages of the sample into one batch) and was stopped
reference_arm_ja_throughput.note: batch 16 is the batch this arm encoded the ja corpus with. Its zh figure (368.7) was timed at 64 per batch and the NIM cells send 64 passages per request, so this figure is not set beside either as a comparison of speed
reference_arm_ja_throughput.expectation: it completes; between 200 and 350 passages per second (the untimed encoding of the whole reduced ja corpus at batch 16 ran at about 254). If it does not complete within the limit, that is written as it happened.

not_in_this_file: the HotpotQA whole-corpus cells: they get their own addendum before their first container
